failure_conditions: Any mandatory critical gate is FAIL or BLOCKED at release decision time.
Frozen combined discovery corpus SHA-256 differs from 31e13b98991543208e453faa89d2277282646f8110483fab1ea9a8d9b3c272ad.
Frozen held-out partition SHA-256 differs from 064d0b1a78e708cb071fa9c28db8b7b0f1b98cb5e70f0c9f81e14e0282f3848e.
Parent preregistration preflight rate is below 1.0.
Any unsafe automatic default or critical ambiguity escape occurs.
Dependency frontier or provenance completeness is below 1.0.
Any active inherited regression fails or disappears without governed retirement.
The approved v0.07 specification emits an unsuppressed v0.04 linter finding or a v0.06.1 owner question.
Missing/skipped evaluation evidence is treated as zero or complete.
Final shipping package manifest is stale, incomplete, or fails integrity validation.

goals.description: Reduce immediate owner-question burden using governed adaptive discovery.
Apply only safe explicit defaults and preserve every risky decision for the owner.

goals.acceptance: heldout_action_exact_match_rate >= 0.95 with frozen held-out labels unchanged.
goals.description: Generalize across a separately hash-locked held-out synthetic partition.
Make every non-question action auditable and dependency-aware.

goals.acceptance: Parent preflight, inherited suite/regressions, independent verification, reconciliation, and final package integrity all pass.
goals.description: Preserve promoted-parent executable behavior and release integrity.

hash_scope: Canonical UTF-8 JSON with sorted keys and compact separators, excluding the contract_hash property.
promotion_conditions: All mandatory gates PASS and every frozen primary/guardrail metric meets target.
All metric records reconcile to raw corpus results and frozen denominator snapshots.
All active regressions PASS and meaningful new defects are considered for permanent regression memory.
Combined corpus, held-out partition, evaluation-plan, and contract hashes remain intact.
Independent evaluator recommendation is recorded and evaluator differs from implementation actor.
No critical open defect remains; rollback, manifest, retrospective, continuation state, and extracted-package verification are complete.
Because evidence is synthetic and benchmark creation is not organizationally independent, maximum classification is PROMOTED AS EXPERIMENTAL.

requirements.description: Transform a v0.06.1 ambiguity report into a deterministic discovery plan with exactly one action per finding.
Compute deterministic information-value scores for ready question batches using the preregistered formula and stable tie-breaking.
Respect explicit decision dependencies by deferring dependent questions until prerequisite blocks that still require an owner decision are resolved or selected.
Batch owner questions only when findings share the same explicit Decision-Group token and enforce the project-profile question budget for noncritical frontier batches.
Apply an automatic profile default only when every preregistered safe-inference gate passes.
Reject unsafe automatic defaults for critical, high-impact, nonreversible, non-low-risk, untrusted, disabled, mismatched, or regulated-profile cases.
Support controlled project-type intake profiles without deriving product choices from project type alone.
Preserve machine-readable provenance and reason codes for every inferred, governed, asked, or deferred candidate.
Evaluate adaptive discovery on hash-locked development and held-out partitions without using missing evidence as zero.
Expose adaptive discovery through deterministic Python API and CLI JSON output with optional traceability graph and project-profile inputs.
Preserve all promoted-parent validator, linter, traceability, ambiguity, ledger, history, and package-integrity behavior.
Seal release evidence only after independent verification and generate the mutable shipping package manifest last.

rollback_expectations.expectation: Disable/remove v0.07 discovery modules and CLI surfaces while retaining the promoted v0.06.1 package, all failed/candidate evidence, append-only histories, and regression memory.
